name: Squeeze Transition
description: The first clip is squeezed to a thin band and disappears, uncovering the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 = squeezeh (the first clip shrinks in height toward a horizontal line), 1 = squeezev (shrinks in width toward a vertical line)
